title: Handful of things shell asks of the window
description: Tauri window calls wrapped here so they work in plain browser with Tauri guard.
body: The handful of things the shell asks of the window it is drawn in. The Tauri window and webview calls live in `bindings.ts` (STANDARDS.md §1.1 — one door). What stays here is `isTauri`, checked immediately before every one of them rather than once at load: both are reachable in a plain browser (`pnpm dev:agent`), with no Tauri runtime underneath to answer them.
